groupings.title: Shared governance
groupings.description: The companion every coordinated Quasar workflow skill reads before acting: routing, interaction cadence, ownership, authority, lifecycle, cited findings, report sources, and stage results.

groupings.title: Ask and evaluate the project
groupings.description: Answer bounded questions from project truth, or evaluate a proposal across fit, value, risk, compatibility, trade-offs, and evidence before choosing deeper work.

groupings.title: Shared tools
groupings.description: Cross-cutting tools for bilingual prose editing, database design evidence, C4 architecture models and views, editable structural diagrams and Marp presentations, Word documents, spreadsheets, PowerPoint files, and runtime-neutral PDF mechanics while owning stages retain project meaning.

groupings.title: Structured ideation and brainstorming
groupings.description: Turn one decision into a traceable candidate space with independent generation, provenance, predeclared criteria, non-compensatory gates, adversarial review, routed evidence requests, and an approved snapshot the owning workflow decides to adopt.

groupings.title: Discovery and commercial proposals
groupings.description: Turn raw client evidence into a traceable discovery brief and a canonical commercial proposal, then render it as a web, DOCX, or PDF channel.

groupings.title: Engagement research
groupings.description: Scope and investigate optional consulting research, run conditional evidence-linked market analysis, synthesize, and baseline general or market decisions.

groupings.title: Product and technical planning
groupings.description: The delivery orchestrator plus the ordered stages that take a product idea to a validated backlog: product core, technical foundation, domain model, architecture, feature decomposition, a conditional design system, and delivery planning.

groupings.title: Understand a codebase
groupings.description: Orient in unfamiliar code before changing it: locate the relevant surface, map one abstraction level up, explain behavior, and research external ground truth.

groupings.title: Align before building
groupings.description: Short alignment passes that turn a vague request into a durable implementation plan, sized to the change.

groupings.title: Write and fix code
groupings.description: Execution skills for building behavior, prototyping, applying a confirmed fix, diagnosing failures, and resolving merge conflicts.

groupings.title: Review and documentation QA
groupings.description: Change-scoped technical review, bounded evidence critique, comment and docstring review, Agent Skill quality diagnostics, and drift auditing for persistent project documentation.

groupings.title: Reporting and presentations
groupings.description: Synthesize approved project artifacts into one versioned report source, then render Markdown, DOCX, PDF, editable Marp source, HTML, images, and branded presentation channels without losing traceability.
